literal: If one enters spending time in the gambling den, it will destroy long-standing wealth and good character.
translation: If a person enters a gambling den and wastes their time there, it will destroy both their inherited wealth and their good character.
modern: சூதாடும் இடத்தில் தன் காலத்தைச் செலுத்தி நுழைந்தால், அது அவனுடைய பழைமையான செல்வத்தையும் நற்பண்பையும் அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the perils of entering a gambling den, referred to here as 'கழகம்'. The phrase 'காலை புகின்' points to the act of entering and wasting one's precious time in such places. The poet emphasizes that gambling does not merely cause financial ruin by wiping out long-standing, inherited wealth ('பழகிய செல்வம்'); it also degrades a person's moral character and innate goodness ('பண்பு'). Thus, the habit of gambling is doubly destructive, stripping a person of both material security and personal integrity.
